[[File:ThreepioArtoo-SWCTP.png|thumb|right|200px|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], [[Droid/Legends|droid]] counterparts.]]
{{Quote|You and Artoo are friends, aren't you?''"<br />"''Oh, no! Companions, perhaps, but I would never call that stubborn, rube, malfunctioning little gob of grease a ''friend''.|[[Nak Pitareeze]] and C-3PO|<ref name="Droids (1994) 1">[[Droids (1994) 1|''Droids'' (1994) 1]]</ref>}}
A '''counterpart''' was one of a group of two or more [[Droid/Legends|droids]] who had been together for a long time and could function together at around 30-35% better than normal droids.<ref name="Heir to the Empire">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>

Such connections could also form between droids and regular [[Computer/Legends|computers]]. By 9 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|ABY]], the computer of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] personal [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-Wing]] had molded itself to [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2's]] unique personality, allowing R2 to work on [[AA-589/Legends|the ship]] with counterpart level efficiency. However, this also meant that the standardized diagnostic equipment used by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] technicians was ineffective, making it impossible to do systems maintenance without R2's assistance. Due to this issue, it was standard procedure to give [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromechs]] regular [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipes]], which Skywalker adamantly refused to do. 

Examples of counterpart pairs included [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>
